premises.text: Churn Labs explores greenfield tech areas by building products there to learn and bump into further opportunities
premises.evidence_span: looking at areas of technology that we think haven't really been fully explored

premises.text: Nonstop Gnomes lets users create a custom digital gnome that lives on only one device, travel-check-in with photos, and hand it off to friends while receiving path updates
premises.evidence_span: build your very own custom gnome and take him with you

premises.text: Lift transfers a gnome between devices via a magical camera viewfinder handoff
Lyft-style interconnectivity lets users drag and drop content such as photos through one device's screen onto another
premises.evidence_span: could I drag and drop through the screen?

value.text: Playful unique digital objects and device interconnectivity that make multi-device experiences more interesting
value.evidence_span: how can I connect them in a more interesting way?

causal_links.evidence_span: just by being there and seeing what we learn, we may bump into even more interesting opportunities
wouldn't it be cool to have a gnome in your pocket?
It's a way of doing a different way of device interconnectivity

notes: Playful/exploratory pitch; value inferred toward interconnectivity learning agenda. Create/travel/notify gnome features folded as one product cascade; Lift kept as transfer mechanism package of that product. Cross-device photo drag-drop (Lyft) split as separately demonstrated second project. Singleton-ish D1 retained: lab exploration stance presented as condition for why these products exist. Demo glitches noted; coded only claimed mechanisms.
